issue.title: Dash PENDING/NEXT badges lose their lane class: setReadyAnchorContent overwrites it with bob-plan-ready
issue.description:
bob-ledger-tools (bob-plugins @ d4197f7, plugin 1.14.0): `renderDashboardLaneBadge` creates the PENDING/NEXT anchor with class `bob-plan-chip bob-plan-<lane>[ bob-plan-over][ bob-plan-unavailable]` (plugins/bob-ledger-tools/main.js ~6544) and then calls the shared `setReadyAnchorContent` (main.js ~3515-3610). That routine unconditionally runs `anchor.setAttribute("class", "bob-plan-chip bob-plan-ready…")` (main.js ~3593-3598). Nothing after it restores the lane class: the follow-up block (~6560-6600) only rewrites the label span and the aria/role/tabindex attributes. So in a real DOM the dash PENDING and NEXT badges lose `bob-plan-pending`/`bob-plan-next` and render with READY's blue accent instead of yellow/green (styles.css:50-98 expects the lane classes). The live refresh path (`paintDashboardLaneElement` ~6548, refresh ~6700-6747) goes through the same routine. Tests miss it because they use stub elements and never assert the class.

Found while researching the per-note READY cap (research:202610/per_note_ready_cap_crowded_notes__cld.md).

task_type_fields.impact: Dash PENDING and NEXT chips show the wrong accent color (blue READY instead of yellow/green), so the lane badges look identical to READY; over-cap red still applies through bob-plan-over only when recomputed from READY's model.
task_type_fields.location: bob-plugins plugins/bob-ledger-tools/main.js setReadyAnchorContent (~3593) called from renderDashboardLaneBadge (~6544) / paintDashboardLaneElement (~6548)
task_type_fields.repro: Open ~/bob/dash.md in Obsidian with bob-ledger-tools 1.14.0 loaded and inspect the PENDING or NEXT chip: its class is `bob-plan-chip bob-plan-ready…`, not `bob-plan-pending…`/`bob-plan-next…`, and it is blue. By reading: main.js `renderDashboardLaneBadge` → `setReadyAnchorContent` → `setAttribute("class", "bob-plan-chip bob-plan-ready…")` with no restore.

issue.creation_reason: Found by code reading while researching the per-note READY cap; the shared READY anchor routine clobbers the lane badge class, so PENDING/NEXT render with READY's color and over/unavailable classes can go stale.

payload.entry: Fixed by epic bob-cli-3f phase ledger-views (bob-cli-3f.4), bob-plugins 91b8e40, bob-ledger-tools 1.16.0: setReadyAnchorContent now takes a {kind} option (ready|pending|next|crowded, default ready) and writes bob-plan-<kind> instead of hard-coding bob-plan-ready. paintDashboardLaneElement (initial render and live refresh) passes {kind: normalized lane}. Regression test 'anchor helper keeps READY, PENDING, NEXT, and CROWDED classes' in scripts/test-ledger-tools-note-ready-views.cjs asserts the class across repeated refreshes. Land agent bob-cli-3f.land reran npm test on bob-plugins master ede89d3: 1185/1185 pass. Deployed vault plugin is 1.17.0. GUI color check in Obsidian not run (no Obsidian runtime on this host).
